title: Agentic Trading: When LLM Agents Meet Financial Markets
short_justification: Strongest current evidence for protocol incomparability; arXiv abstract reports 77 included studies, a primary empirical subset of 19, limited transaction-cost reporting, and no R3 reproducibility.

title: Finance Agent Benchmark: Benchmarking LLMs on Real-world Financial Research Tasks
short_justification: Highly relevant to investment research tasks; arXiv abstract reports 537 expert-authored questions using SEC filings and best model accuracy of 46.8 percent, showing current limitations.

title: FinRobot: AI Agent for Equity Research and Valuation with Large Language Models
short_justification: Directly relevant to investment research agents; arXiv abstract describes Data-CoT, Concept-CoT, and Thesis-CoT agents plus open-source release, but professional workflow evaluation and auditability remain limited.

title: Evaluation and Benchmarking Suite for Financial Large Language Models and Agents
short_justification: Relevant to evaluation lifecycle and governance; arXiv abstract describes evaluation pipeline, governance framework, leaderboard, AgentOps, and documentation platform.

title: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
short_justification: Important baseline for multi-agent trading workflow, but claims require careful reproduction, transaction-cost checks, and audit review.

title: FinMem: A Performance-Enhanced LLM Trading Agent with Layered Memory and Character Design
short_justification: Important for memory-based financial agents, but mainly trading-decision focused and not a full investment thesis workflow.

title: FinRobot: An Open-Source AI Agent Platform for Financial Applications using Large Language Models
short_justification: Useful open-source financial agent infrastructure; formal evaluation and audit standards remain underdeveloped.

title: BloombergGPT: A Large Language Model for Finance
short_justification: Important finance-domain LLM baseline, but proprietary data/model reduces external reproducibility and it is not an agent system.

title: FinGPT: Open-Source Financial Large Language Models
short_justification: Important open-source finance LLM infrastructure, but not by itself an investment research agent framework.

title: From Deep Learning to LLMs: A survey of AI in Quantitative Investment
short_justification: Useful positioning within the quantitative investment pipeline; auditability and investment-research-agent workflow are not the main contribution.
